_readme: Flows that predate the folder contract and the no-custom-colour rule. legacyLayout: flows check:structure skips (written by node scripts/check-structure.mjs --baseline after a migration). colourBudget: raw colour / font literals each older flow may keep; npm run lint:tokens fails above it, so it only goes down (node scripts/token-lint.mjs --baseline). A flow missing from both is held to the full contract.
